report.summary: UPI checkout timeouts and payments-api latency spikes were caused by performance degradation in the external partner-bank-api, which caused upi-gateway worker threads to block and exhaust the worker pool, leading to timeouts across payments-api.

supporting.note: upi-gateway logs show slow calls to partner-bank-api starting at 13:42.
upi-gateway worker pool exhausted waiting on partner-bank-api.
p99 latency jumped significantly starting at 13:45.

contradicting.note: Metrics backend returned partial data missing latency and error rate metrics.

supporting.note: Worker pool exhausted (200/200 busy), rejecting requests.

contradicting.note: Worker pool size of 200 was previously deemed sufficient under normal conditions; exhaustion is secondary to downstream slowness.

facts.text: payments-api error rate and p99 latency spiked starting around 13:45-13:47 UTC.
upi-gateway logged slow responses from partner-bank-api starting at 13:42:16 UTC.
upi-gateway worker pool became exhausted and rejected requests starting at 13:47:40 UTC.
No code deployments occurred for payments-api or upi-gateway in the preceding 24 hours.

assumptions: External partner-bank-api experienced database or internal service degradation causing synchronous calls to hang.
Customer-facing UPI payment timeouts correlate directly with the payments-api and upi-gateway request timeouts.
evidence_gaps: Metrics backend returned partial data missing error rate and p99 latency for partner-bank-api.
Log shards timed out resulting in incomplete log match counts for upi-gateway.

timeline.event: First slow call to partner-bank-api logged by upi-gateway
First payments-api timeout error calling upi-gateway
payments-api and mobile-bff error rate anomalies start
upi-gateway worker pool exhaustion and request rejection

recommended_actions.action: Coordinate with partner bank ops team to verify partner-bank-api performance.
recommended_actions.rationale: Partner bank degradation is the root cause of downstream worker pool exhaustion and payment timeouts.

recommended_actions.action: Implement or tune circuit breakers on upi-gateway for partner-bank-api calls.
recommended_actions.rationale: Failing fast prevents thread starvation and worker pool exhaustion during third-party degradation.

recommended_actions.action: Add non-blocking I/O or asynchronous patterns for external dependency calls.
recommended_actions.rationale: Protects internal gateways from being bottlenecked by synchronous third-party API latency.
